announcements.headline: EQS-News: FUCHS reports strong first nine months of 2026
announcements.insight: Fuchs Petrolub SE Pref Shs (0LCR) reports strong first nine months of 2026. This follows its strong first half results in July 2026.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: FUCHS expands presence in Africa through strategic investments
announcements.insight: Fuchs Petrolub SE expands presence in Africa through strategic investments. This follows earlier announcements regarding a Saudi Arabian joint venture facility and strong first-half results.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: FUCHS SE and Mercedes-Benz announce extension to strategic business partnership
announcements.insight: FUCHS SE extends its strategic partnership with Mercedes-Benz. This follows strong first-half results and facility expansions announced in July and August.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: FUCHS announces grand opening of Americas Technology Center in Massachusetts
announcements.insight: Fuchs Petrolub SE Pref Shs (0LCR) announces the grand opening of its Americas Technology Center in Massachusetts. This follows earlier reports of strong first half results and Supervisory Board changes.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Production facility of FUCHS joint venture ALHAMRANI FUCHS PETROLEUM Saudi-Arabia severely damaged – no injuries
announcements.insight: Damage to a joint venture facility in Saudi Arabia is reported. This follows strong first-half results announced in July 2026.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: FUCHS reports strong first half of 2026
announcements.insight: Fuchs Petrolub SE Pref Shs (0LCR) reports strong first half of 2026. This follows earlier governance updates regarding Supervisory Board changes planned for 2027.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: FUCHS SE announces changes to the Supervisory Board planned for 2027
announcements.insight: Fuchs Petrolub SE Pref Shs (0LCR) announces planned changes to its Supervisory Board for 2027. This board change affects corporate governance structure.
